 SOMERSET, Mass. (WJAR) — Somerset police said on Saturday that they arrested three people in connection with a check fraud scheme at the Citizens Bank at 815 Grand Army Highway.
 Stasha Medeiros, Andre Cairo, and Rajheem Chardonnette, were arrested and charged with attempting to commit a crime uttering a false check and conspiracy.
 An additional person was summoned for their involvement in the crime, they were also charged.
 According to the department, officers were called to the bank on Oct. 28 for reports of a woman who was allegedly attempting to commit check fraud.
 Officers were able to stop the woman after she entered a vehicle near the bank.

 After investigating, police found that the woman had attempted to cash a $35,000 check into a bank account opened the day prior.
 The bank teller contacted the business that reportedly issued the check and they verified that the check was fraudulent.
 The fraudulent check had been made out in the suspect's name.
